name: @lokarent/db
description: Prisma database client and schema for LokaRent

scripts.migrate: set -a; . ../../.env; set +a; prisma migrate dev --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.migrate:create: set -a; . ../../.env; set +a; prisma migrate dev --create-only --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.migrate:deploy: set -a; . ../../.env; set +a; prisma migrate deploy --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.migrate:status: set -a; . ../../.env; set +a; prisma migrate status --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.migrate:reset: set -a; . ../../.env; set +a; prisma migrate reset --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:pull: set -a; . ../../.env; set +a; prisma db pull --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.check: pnpm prisma:format && pnpm prisma:validate && pnpm prisma:generate
